articles.title: "Politically Motivated": BJP As Kangana Ranaut Faces FIR In Himachal, Congress Responds
articles.summary: A police case was filed against BJP MP and actor Kangana Ranaut in Himachal Pradesh over her social media posts targeting the Gandhi family.

articles.title: My real mission is to see Tricolour on Moon by 2040: Captain Shubhanshu Shukla
articles.summary: Shukla said he never felt alone during Axiom Mission 4 that took him to space and back in June 2025, "because the whole nation was part of the mission".

articles.title: BJP MLA’s son makes reel inside Ujjain's Mahakal temple, action initiated against security firm
articles.summary: The temple committee said Rudraksh Shukla would be allowed to visit only as an ordinary devotee, without access to protocol arrangements.

articles.title: Delhi High Court Denies Bail To Councillor In Sanitary Worker's Suicide Case
articles.summary: The victim allegedly died by suicide by hanging at his residence following alleged pressure and harassment at the hands of the petitioner. An FIR in connection with the matter was registered at the police station.

articles.title: India no longer a democracy, says Rahul Gandhi at Bharat Summit in Hyderabad
articles.summary: Gandhi cited Maharashtra's voter data, alleging that around 7 million additional voters were added to the rolls between the Lok Sabha and assembly elections.

articles.title: Man Arrested Over Social Media Post On 'Fish Deaths' In Yamuna In Delhi
articles.summary: The man had allegedly uploaded a video on social media from the Wazirabad Water Treatment Plant, which circulated on social media amid concerns over the reported deaths of fish in the Yamuna.

articles.title: ‘BJP betrayed people of India by breaking promises’: SP's Akhilesh Yadav at HT Leadership Summit
articles.summary: Yadav said law-and-order had deteriorated in UP, rejecting the perception that frequent encounters and “bulldozer justice” were a sign of improved policing.

articles.title: SP has made up its mind on how many seats it will contest in UP elections: Akhilesh Yadav at HT Leadership Summit
articles.summary: Yadav refused to speculate whether he had reached out to the Bahujan Samaj Party but said that the Bahujan community will defeat the Bharatiya Janata Party.
